contexts.text: Seba, Havillah, Sabtah, Raamah, Sabteca () = 80 many nations, with which were the Knowledges of faith; and by which are signified the Knowledges themselves.
Sheba and Seba () = the internal things of worship; Sheba, the celestial things of worship; and Seba the spiritual things. ( = the Knowledges of good and truth. AC 9293:4.)
Cush and Seba () = the spiritual things of faith. AC 1171:2.
